title: Non-commutative rings with infinitely many maximal subrings
summary: We study rings with infinitely (only finitely) many maximal subrings. We prove that if $M$ is a maximal left/right ideal of a ring $T$ which is not an ideal of $T$, and $R$ is the idealizer of $M$, then $T$ has at least $|R/M|+1$ maximal left/right ideals which are not an ideal of $T$; in particular $T$ has at least $|R/M|+1$ distinct maximal subrings. Moreover, if $T$ is a $K$-algebra over an infinite field $K$, then either $T$ has infinitely many maximal subrings or $T$ is a quasi duo ring with certain algebraic properties similar to commutative rings.
